experiment: After both existing joint strategies fail, try one additional joint strategy with each diagonal facing projection split at the midpoint of its wall-feasible interval. Skip identical cuts and preserve all start/completion callbacks and exact final checks.
decision: REJECTED: production implementation removed; obstacle regression cases retained for the existing solver.
reason: No observed board recovery; proposed synthetic recovery fixtures also pass through existing strategies. The explicit assertion requiring a new-strategy witness failed. Extra work is not justified by current evidence.

tests_during_experiment.stronger_witness_assertion: FAIL: obstructed fixtures never exercised balanced facing recovery
tests_during_experiment.lesson: A passing feasibility fixture does not show the new algorithm caused recovery. Require an executed-strategy witness and a baseline comparison.

limits: Single-run uncontrolled construction timings, not independent full qualification or historical Python comparisons. Failed searches do not prove geometric infeasibility. Extra midpoint strategies are not a substitute for obstacle-conditioned or coupled-axis reasoning.
retained_tests: Eight mirrored/axis-swapped full-span obstacle cases additionally check board containment, exact facing, obstacle separation and paired joint callbacks. Original production solver rebuilt: compact retry PASS 5.94s, floorplan PASS 13.97s. See native/build/facing-balanced-revert-tests.log.
